spots.label: NE · Second Avenue / Main Avenue
spots.selection_rationale: A clear junction labelled Second Avenue and Main Avenue in the independent raster; both road centerlines meet at the same source node in the existing OSM package.

manual_observation.summary: The OS window labels Main Avenue and Second Avenue at the marked T-junction. The registered OSM centerlines meet at the same source node and lie within the broad mapped road corridor; the actual 3D capture shows the connected junction among the same building rows. This is a qualitative placement match only; no numeric offset was measured.
manual_observation.method: Side-by-side OS reference, registered overlay, OSM-only package map, and actual WebGL scene review.
manual_observation.screening_assessment: No visible discrepancy exceeding the 10 m investigation trigger was apparent at this map scale; this is not a measured accuracy result.
